topics.name: Needs Attention
topics.answer:
NurseTrack Action Center summarizes critical operational alerts requiring supervisor action:

• Expired & Expiring PRC Licenses (Urgent / 6-Month Renewal Window)
• Overdue Scheduled Staff Trainings
• Expired Training Certifications
• Unassigned Staff / Pending Area Transfers

Open Dashboard to resolve individual alerts.

topics.name: Find Staff
questions: How many nurses and attendants do we have?
topics.answer:
NurseTrack Staff Directory manages Registered Nurses (RN) and Nursing Attendants (NA) across all SKTI clinical units.

You can search staff by name, employee ID, PRC license number, or filter by clinical unit.

topics.name: License Status
questions: What is the PRC license status?
Are any licenses due for renewal?
topics.answer:
NurseTrack monitors PRC licenses against hospital compliance thresholds:

• Expired: Immediate suspension of clinical duties until verified renewal.
• Within 6 Months: Renewal in progress, staff reminder dispatched.
• Within 1 Year: Advance renewal notice.
• Valid: Active in good standing.

topics.name: Training Follow-up
questions: Who has not responded to training assignment?
topics.answer:
Training Follow-up tracks training assignments requiring supervisor action:

• Pending Response: Staff notified but haven't accepted assignment.
• Cannot Attend: Staff submitted scheduling conflicts.
• Missing Email: Staff without valid email for reminders.
• Evidence Review: Certificates uploaded by staff awaiting verification.
• Attendance Pending: Scheduled dates passed without attendance outcome.

topics.name: Upcoming Seminars
topics.answer: NurseTrack Seminars & LDI module tracks multi-day hospital seminars, skill workshops, and leadership interventions with venue assignments and enrolled staff rosters.

topics.name: Reports
questions: How do I export license or training reports?
topics.answer:
NurseTrack provides 6 verified compliance reports with Excel (.xlsx) export and print capabilities:

1. License Status Masterlist: All active staff with PRC number, validity, and renewal status.
2. Expiring & Due Licenses: Priority renewal watch list for upcoming expirations.
3. Training Compliance Matrix: Required vs completed trainings per clinical unit.
4. Area Exposure History: Historical clinical station rotations and cumulative tenure.
5. Training Summary Ledger: Staff certifications, categories, and renewal obligations.
6. Area Transfer History Log: Complete audit trail of staff reassignments.
